title: new scc cobblemon
description: A mod pack made for the room that I work in at college along with for me and my friends.
body: This is my pack made for the room that I work in for fun. This has a lot of the create mod and cobblemon in it. Create is a steampunk like mod where you can build and create stuff and try to have fun with your friends while the. cobblemon mod is a mod that is basically Pokémon within Minecraft. This mod pack is meant to be encouraging creativity, exploration, and automation. Your goal is to go around the world, find where different Pokémon spawn, and create a bunch of automated machines to capture them, breed them, or make different poker balls, potions, or anything that you'll need for your journey to be the number one Pokémon trainer. This mod pack is using both. Mega showdowns and all of the Mons. So have fun and there is a couple add-on mods to make it to where you could play with you and your friends for free without needing to pay for a server just as long as one of you. Guys have a good PC. Have fun with the mods and have a great day.
